title: LeafLog
tagline: LeafLog is an ai agent which generates transaction statements of an account in a pdf file.
description: This project lets the user generate transaction statements of their account by choosing the account, chain, and time duration in a PDF file which can be downloaded or shared via email. This wallet statement can be further shared with the governmental authorities to calculate their crypto tax in any country. Sometimes users need to submit their bank or crypto statements to pay their taxes when residing in a foreign country or moving from a foreign country. This helps users organize all the crypto transactions in a pdf file and they don't have to manually prepare the wallet statements which is time-consuming, confusing, and not understandable by a non-crypto person.
how_its_made: This project uses The Graph to fetch all the transactions from a wallet from different chains such as Arbitrum, and Base, integrate with email service, and other tools to prepare the pdf document. Prepare it as an AI agent and deploy it on Autonome or other platforms.
